verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs state it 'is open-source and freely available for anyone to host themselves' and is offered 'under an MIT license'. The public GitHub repository (github.com/PostHog/posthog, including service READMEs such as services/mcp) shows the source is readable. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the repository LICENSE file and of which parts of the codebase the MIT license covers (the docs tie it to the Docker Compose deployment), plus independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: PostHog is open-source and freely available for anyone to host themselves. We offer a free Docker Compose deployment under an MIT license.
